page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 instance built on the KVM hypervisor, powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The hardware layout comprises 96 vCPUs and 768.0 GB of RAM, resulting in an 8.0 GB per core memory allocation. This configuration provides a high-density 1:8 CPU-to-memory ratio suited for memory-intensive computing tasks. Network infrastructure supports up to 32 Gbps of baseline bandwidth.

The server does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for operating system and data persistence. It also omits discrete GPU hardware accelerators. The system architecture prioritizes high CPU clock rates alongside massive RAM capacity, making compute and memory throughput the primary hardware features rather than storage speed or parallel matrix execution.

Given its resource density, ecs.hfr7.24xlarge provides a specialized balance of high clock speed and substantial memory capacity. The instance is designed for large-scale enterprise workloads, including in-memory databases, real-time analytics engines, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-heavy ETL processing workflows.
